title: ACS red evidence is head-truncated to ~600 chars — always build noise, never the '--- FAIL:' line, so every red predicate is undiagnosable
notes: acssuite excerpt() caps EvidenceExcerpt at evidenceMax=600 (acssuite.go:43) taken from the HEAD of the output. A `go test` run's first 600 chars are compiler/WARN noise, so the failing test name is ALWAYS truncated away. Measured across all 5 reds in 1107/1115/1116/1117: evidence_len 593-601 and '--- FAIL:' present in NONE. For 1107 and 1116 no AUDIT-TIME failing test name survives anywhere on disk — why those cycles failed is permanently unrecoverable, and it is the reason audit-probe-tree-isolation cannot be confirmed for them. IMPORTANT for the builder: `go test -json` parsing and per-test output scoping ALREADY EXIST (parseGoTestJSON, acssuite.go:505-519) — do NOT re-plumb them. The lost bytes are the INNER subprocess text a meta-predicate t.Logf'd as free-form, which acssuite cannot restructure from outside. PRIMARY FIX (~10 lines): make excerpt() TAIL-anchored, which is also cycle-1116's own retro Preventive Action 1. Secondary: record why no test name could be extracted (compile failure, timeout, signal) rather than emitting a content-free exit code.
acceptance: RED first: a golden go-test stream whose first 600 bytes are build noise and whose failure is at the tail -> the Result carries the failing test name; asserted absent before the fix.
Every red Result either names >=1 failing test or explicitly records why none could be extracted.
The retained raw excerpt is TAIL-anchored; evidenceMax stays a named constant.
Backfill is impossible by construction — 1107/1116 stay unrecoverable; the item says so.
